reasons.claim: Notified regeneration felling, small polygon (1.37 ha), status notified; no completed felling overlap (0%).

Two eligible species within 250 m: Haploporus odorus (doftticka, VU, fungus; nearest record 0 m i.e. inside polygon, 2019, 10 m uncertainty; threats include lack of continuity forest and old/large trees) and Goodyera repens (knärot, VU, vascular plant; 10 records, nearest 125 m, latest 2024; threats include lack of dead wood and increased openness).

Six site-bound forest NT species also recorded within 250 m (e.g. Lobaria pulmonaria, Lobaria scrobiculata, Bryoria nadvornikiana, Pseudographis pinicola, Chaenotheca gracillima, Phellinidium ferrugineofuscum), supporting evidence.
Effort is adequate (109 records, 84th percentile vs county median 26); near-site 1 record inside the polygon and 41 within 250 m across 3 observation days.

uncertainties: The inside-polygon fungus record is from 2019; the 2024 records are 125 m or more away.
Records are from only a few observation days, so they show recording, not current occupancy of the stand to be felled.
not_established: Whether the species currently occur on the felled area
Forest condition or biodiversity of the site
next_action: Reviewer should check the 2019 doftticka record position against the polygon and the 2024 knärot and lichen records nearby, and consider a field inventory before felling starts.
